name: Bosch Expert for Inox 2608603413 4-Inch (100mm x 1.2mm) Metal Cutting Wheel
shortDescription: Genuine Bosch Expert for Inox 100mm cutting disc (Model 2608603413) free of ferrous and sulfurous fillers, engineered for cool cutting of stainless steel.
overview: The Bosch Expert for Inox cutting disc (Part No. 2608603413) is engineered to meet the demanding requirements of stainless steel (Inox) fabrication where contamination and corrosion prevention are paramount. Formulated with premium aluminium oxide abrasive grains and functional cooling fillers in an advanced phenol resin matrix, it cuts without overheating the workpiece, preventing the chrome-carbide depletion that leads to tea-staining and rust. Containing less than 0.1% iron, sulfur, and chlorine, it meets the strict cleanliness demands of pharmaceutical, food processing, and dairy equipment manufacturing.
keyFeatures: Genuine Bosch Expert class consumable engineered for professional metal fabrication
Inox formulation free from iron, sulfur, and chlorinated fillers (< 0.1% Fe/S/Cl)
1.2mm slim thickness provides effortless cutting with low power consumption
Generates minimal heat, burrs, and spark scatter during high-speed cutting
Premium fiberglass reinforcing fabric ensures ultimate burst resistance at 15,300 RPM
Certified to EN 12413 safety norms and oSa (Organisation for the Safety of Abrasives)
Compatible with all 100mm (4-inch) angle grinders featuring standard 16mm spindles

applications: Stainless steel sanitary piping and tank fabrication for food/pharma plants
Architectural stainless steel handrails, balustrades, and elevator trims
Structural steel square hollow sections (SHS) and round pipe cutting
